violation_type.title: Notification of Addition of Swimming Pool (26 TAC §744.301(4))
violation_type.short_title: Notification of Addition of Swimming Pool
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation did not notify Child Care Regulation when the community center swimming pool was finished and the children in care started using it. This was corrected during the inspection when the director notified CCR that they had started using the swimming pool.
